title: Cake or Cupcake with Peanut Butter

content.title: About
content.content: A cake or cupcake with peanut butter is a baked treat where a lightly sweetened, tender crumb is paired with the rich, nutty flavor of peanut butter. It works well for celebrations or everyday indulgence, offering a pleasant balance of sweetness and savory depth.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peanut butter has been used in American cooking for over a century, famously in the classic PB&J sandwich.
Peanut‑butter cakes are often topped with chocolate ganache, caramel drizzle, or crushed peanuts for extra texture.
The oil in peanut butter helps keep the cake moist and extends its freshness.
In some regions, peanut‑butter cupcakes are a traditional fall‑time dessert.

items.title: Rich in healthy fats
items.content: Peanut butter provides monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats that support heart health.

items.title: Good source of plant protein
items.content: Two tablespoons (~32 g) deliver about 8 g of protein, aiding muscle repair.

items.title: Contains vitamin E
items.content: Vitamin E acts as an antioxidant, protecting cells from oxidative damage.

items.title: May help regulate blood sugar
items.content: The healthy fats slow carbohydrate absorption from the cake, helping to stabilize glucose levels.

items.title: Provides essential minerals
items.content: Peanut butter supplies magnesium, phosphorus, and potassium, important for nerve and muscle function.

items.title: Peanut allergy
items.content: Peanuts are a major allergen; reactions can be severe for sensitive individuals.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Peanut butter is calorie‑rich (~190 kcal per 2 Tbsp), so portion control is advisable.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Salted varieties add extra sodium; opting for unsalted versions is healthier.

items.title: Aflatoxin risk
items.content: Poorly processed peanut butter may contain aflatoxins, a toxin produced by mold. Choose reputable brands.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the cake or cupcake as a standalone dessert, slice into portions, and garnish with fresh berries, fruit sauce, or a sprinkle of chopped peanuts. It also works well as a base for parfait‑style desserts layered with whipped cream or yogurt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the finished cake or cupcakes in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days. For longer storage (up to 1 week) refrigerate. Freeze in a sealed bag if you need to keep them for several months.
